subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Inadvertant"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Inadvertent"**. (अनजाने में या असावधानी से)

 
 
• **Example: **He made an inadvertent mistake while filling out the form.
 
 
 
• **"Inadvertent"** means not resulting from or achieved through deliberate planning; unintentional. (अनजाने में या असावधानी से)
 
 
• **Example: **The damage to the painting was inadvertent, caused by the fall of a ladder.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Synchronous** (समकालीन): Occurring at the same time or rate.

 
 
• **Example:** The dancers moved in synchronous harmony with the music.
 
 
 
• **Effeminate** (स्त्रैण): Having or showing characteristics regarded as typical of a woman; unmanly.
 
 
• **Example:** He was criticized for his effeminate mannerisms by his peers.
 
 
 
• **Blatant** (स्पष्ट): Done openly and unashamedly; very obvious.
 
 
• **Example:** The politician's blatant lies were exposed during the press conference.
